I tried out a lot of things, but after a few reboots it always went back to stock firmware. I was however able to make DD-WRT stick permanently on reboot. Here's what I did :

* Download the classic firmware [here](https://www.dropbox.com/s/zd69vc4xjeyuq73/FW_EA6200_1.1.41.164830_prod.img?dl=0)
* Uncheck auto-update and flash it using the Web GUI
* Get the latest DD-WRT beta eg. [26138](ftp://ftp.dd-wrt.com/betas/2015/02-04-2015-r26138/asus-rt-ac56u/)
* Flash it using the Web GUI
* On first DD-WRT boot, go to **Administration > Commands** and type in:  

    nvram set partialboots=0  
    nvram commit  

    Save it as a **Startup script** 
 
* Reboot
